design_gotchas.title: Output Capacitor ESR Must Stay <= 100 mOhm (Avoid Tantalum/Electrolytic Caps)
design_gotchas.detail: Table 5.3 on Page 5 enforces a strict 100 mOhm maximum output capacitor ESR (with 0.47 uF to 200 uF effective capacitance). High-ESR tantalum or aluminum electrolytic capacitors can violate stability and degrade the 95 dB PSRR / 7 uVRMS noise performance; use low-ESR X5R/X7R MLCCs placed directly at OUT and GND.

design_gotchas.title: Ground Current Scales From 6.5 uA (No Load) to 2.0 mA Typ at Full 300 mA Load
design_gotchas.detail: While no-load IQ is an ultra-low 6.5 uA typ (even in dropout at 0 mA), Table 5.5 reveals IGND rises to 2,000 uA (2.0 mA) typ at IOUT = 300 mA to sustain the 95 dB PSRR and 7 uVRMS noise loop bandwidth. Include this load-dependent ground current in heavy-load power budgets.

design_gotchas.title: No Internal Reverse-Current Protection — Limit Reverse Current to <= 5% Rated (15 mA)
design_gotchas.detail: VOUT abs max is min(6.5 V, VIN + 0.3 V), and the datasheet warns that reverse current from OUT to IN during input collapse can damage the device unless limited to <= 5% of rated output current (15 mA) for brief events or bypassed with an external Schottky diode.

design_gotchas.title: Ultra-Low 7 uVRMS Noise Achieved With Pin 4 = N/C (Not BYP/NR)
design_gotchas.detail: Unlike legacy low-noise RF LDOs (AP2210K, LP2985, CAT6219) that require an external bypass cap on Pin 4, TPS7A2033PDBVR leaves Pin 4 N/C while delivering 7 uVRMS noise and 95 dB PSRR at 1 kHz — making it an easy RF upgrade on standard 1=IN, 2=GND, 3=EN, 4=NC, 5=OUT footprints (note 750 us typ / 1150 us max startup time).

typical_use_cases: Ultra-low-noise RF, VCO, PLL, ADC/DAC, and camera image-sensor 3.3 V rails (7 uVRMS, 95 dB PSRR @ 1 kHz)
Low-Iq battery-powered precision analog and portable medical sensors needing 6.5 uA standby IQ
Post-DC/DC buck ripple cleanup at 100 kHz–1 MHz (75 dB PSRR @ 100 kHz, 45 dB @ 1 MHz) without a Pin-4 bypass cap
Drop-in low-noise upgrade candidate on standard SOT-23-5 (Pin 4 = NC) boards up to 300 mA
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments TPS7A2033PDBVR is a premier 300 mA ultra-low-noise (7 uVRMS, 10 Hz–100 kHz), ultra-high-PSRR (95 dB at 1 kHz, 75 dB at 100 kHz) fixed 3.3 V (±1.5% over -40°C to +125°C) LDO in a 5-pin DBV SOT-23-5 package (1=IN, 2=GND, 3=EN smart active-high, 4=N/C, 5=OUT with 150 Ohm discharge). Operating from 1.6 V to 6.0 V (6.5 V abs max), it achieves <= 145 mV max dropout at 300 mA (DBV) and 6.5 uA no-load IQ without needing a Pin-4 noise-bypass capacitor. Engineers must keep COUT ESR <= 100 mOhm, note 2 mA IGND at 300 mA load, and add external protection against reverse bias.
